# Rainbow Gum

> Rainbow Gum _VERSION_ is a modular JDK 21+ logging framework. It implements SLF4J, System.Logger, java.util.logging, the Log4j2 API and JBoss Logging, and is configured with properties (Spring Boot style `logging.*` keys) or Java builders instead of XML.

Links are relative to this file, which sits at the root of the Rainbow Gum javadoc.
Use the documentation version that matches the application's Rainbow Gum dependency.
These guides cover using Rainbow Gum in applications, not contributing to Rainbow Gum itself.

## Docs

- [User guide](overview.md): the whole user guide as Markdown: installation, configuration properties, levels, routes, formats, outputs, framework integrations and troubleshooting.
- [Javadoc](index.html): the HTML javadoc of every module, the user guide included.

## Guides

- [Migrating from Logback](migrate-logback.md): steps for an agent moving a project from Logback to Rainbow Gum, including Spring Boot.
- [Migrating from Log4j2](migrate-log4j2.md): replace Log4j Core while keeping Log4j2 API calls; translate configuration and check compatibility, including Spring Boot.

## Optional

- [Source and README](https://github.com/jstachio/rainbowgum): the GitHub repository.
